docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $150.00 FILED BY ALMENDARES GERARD AS TO DEFENDANT MIRACLE MILE INVESTMENT CO. ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR NOV-28-1994 AT 07:00 PM IN DEPT 01
SUBSTITUTED PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT MIRACLE MILE INVESTMENT CO.
